resources.string: NFC is on and this app can scan tags when the reader is built (M2).
Enable NFC in system settings; the app cannot read or write tags while it is off.
This device has no NFC chip. Scanning and writing stay unavailable; other screens remain for reference.
Read and decode a nearby tag.
Compose a message and write it to a tag.
History view lands in milestone M4; task profiles in M5. This screen shows only real device state, never sample tag data.
Tag discovery, NDEF parsing and the tag detail screen are milestone M2 work. Until then no tag is read, and no simulated tag data is shown.
The record builder, encoded-size preview, capacity checks and verified writing are milestone M3 work. Nothing is written to a tag yet.
Allowlisted actions, confirmation policy and a local execution log are milestone M5 work. Tag payloads are never auto-executed.
Local scan history, search, favourites and export are milestone M4 work. No scan data is stored yet.
Theme, privacy and export preferences follow the persistence milestone (M4). The app currently follows the system theme.
